text:
she says she knows nothing of the fear of the death of love

she says she is afraid of the death of love

she says that love is death is fear

she says that death is fear is love

she says she does not know


only thirst

silence

no encounter


beware of me my love

beware of the silent woman in the desert

of the traveler with the empty glass

and of the shadow of her shadow

translation.title: From Diana's Tree
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the incantatory she says and the poem's bare, unpunctuated warnings.
